mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns as recession risks rise within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% monthly indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns through elevated corporate earnings expectations within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint RSAFS and HOUST growth >0.5% MoM fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns as equity valuations adjust to reduced corporate output within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3% annualized) signals sustained economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% monthly increase in CPIAUCSL signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of Fed tightening that depresses S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.2% MoM) and unemployment decline (UNRATE falls > 0.1pp MoM) indicate a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns through wage-driven consumer spending within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS growth >0.2% MoM and UNRATE decline >0.1pp MoM fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In the low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a further decline in the federal funds rate accelerates equity valuation expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.
